dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals with chronic conditions enrolled in high deductible health plans linked to health savings accounts.
dimensions.evidence: The additional preventive care services and items for chronic conditions... set forth in IRS Notice 2019-45

dimensions.assessment: Codifies existing administrative guidance into statutory law without altering the basic structure of health savings accounts.
dimensions.evidence: The additional preventive care services and items for chronic conditions... shall have the same force and effect as if included in the enactment of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Codifies tax-related administrative guidelines regarding deductible exceptions for specified medical items.
Applies narrowly to internal revenue code provisions governing preventive care definitions for high deductible health plans.
dimensions.evidence: purposes of section 223(c)(2)(C) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986

dimensions.assessment: Makes the statutory codification of the IRS guidance permanent.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides statutory force and effect to prior IRS administrative guidance allowing specific chronic condition items and preventive care to be covered under high deductible health plans without minimum deductibles.
